name: DockAppointmentScheduler
tagline: Every door, every truck, every minute – book, check in and turn trucks around on one Power Apps door board.
description: A complete dock appointment app for warehouses, distribution centres and 3PLs: a door × time board with click-to-book and drag-and-drop rescheduling, door rules (inbound / outbound, reefer, side-load, closed) and conflict checks, carrier self-service requests on Power Pages, gate check-in with trailer and driver, at-door and completion times, late and no-show detection, dwell and detention clocks, a live yard & gate queue, a week door-load heatmap, carrier performance and KPIs. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Door × time board with now line, click-to-book and drag-and-drop rescheduling
Door rules: inbound / outbound only, reefer, side-load, closed
Overlap, dock-hours and reference checks on every booking and move
Suggested duration from pallets and load type
Requested → Booked → Checked in → At door → Completed with No-show, Cancel, Reinstate and Re-open
Roles: scheduler, gate / dock clerk, carrier self-service with lead time
Late and no-show-due flags, on-time arrival %
Dwell, wait for a door, door time and detention with cost exposure
Week door-load heatmap and carrier performance
History, undo, search, filters, sorting, grouping
Power Fx outputs and events (ScheduleCsv, SummaryJson, NewRecordJson)
